comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: When you run out of cannons, run in straight for the admiral and deck battle! If you are strictly after levels it's effective. Around Japan you get around 200 xp for the deck battle and then full xp for the rest of the fleet the same as if you had sank all of them. Arms skill ranks up with every fight just like it would in a cannon/melee fight. The only downside is you get no fame.
